subject: Casa do Benfica Club License Violation
overview: The Commission approved a new malt and wine license and addressed a violation involving a local club operating as an unlicensed restaurant.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the voting of minutes approval to the March 15 meeting.

items.title: New License: Matsuba Itakaya
items.summary: Approved a new malt and wine license for Matsuba Itakaya at 38 Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Club License Compliance: Casa do Benfica
items.summary: Issued a warning to Casa do Benfica for operating as a restaurant open to the public rather than a members-only club. The Commission noted that the establishment had been advertising specials on social media and serving non-members without checking for identification.

items.title: Compliance Procedures and Regulatory Training
items.summary: Discussed resuming regular police compliance checks and scheduling upcoming regulatory training sessions with the Alcoholic Beverages Control Commission.
